A_MEASUREMENT_ERROR_THIS_LANE_MADE_AND_C.severity: MATERIAL. It inverted a dispositive finding.
A_MEASUREMENT_ERROR_THIS_LANE_MADE_AND_C.what_was_first_measured: This lane initially searched AppData/Local/com.vercel.cli and AppData/Roaming/com.vercel.cli, found only a package-update cache, and concluded NO VERCEL CREDENTIAL EXISTS ON THIS MACHINE. That conclusion was written into an earlier draft of this record as reason R3-1, marked DISPOSITIVE.
A_MEASUREMENT_ERROR_THIS_LANE_MADE_AND_C.what_a_wider_search_found: A subsequent exhaustive search located a Vercel credential at AppData/Roaming/xdg.data/com.vercel.cli/auth.json — a path neither of the two targeted probes covered, because the CLI stores its data under an xdg.data subdirectory rather than directly under Roaming.
A_MEASUREMENT_ERROR_THIS_LANE_MADE_AND_C.the_failure_class: This is RC-3 exactly: AN EMPTY RESULT FROM ONE TOOL READ AS AN ABSENCE IN THE WORLD. It is the same failure CM-4 recorded when an empty CLI alias table was read as an absence of aliases, and the same failure DF-5 warns about for a pattern-scoped ls-remote. The lane applying those controls committed the error they describe, in the act of applying them.
A_MEASUREMENT_ERROR_THIS_LANE_MADE_AND_C.why_it_is_recorded_rather_than_silently_: The false version was dispositive: it would have justified this determination on a ground that does not exist. A certifier re-running the narrow probe would reproduce the false negative and might conclude the wider finding was the error. Recording both, and which is correct, is the only way the next reader can tell.
A_MEASUREMENT_ERROR_THIS_LANE_MADE_AND_C.the_control_this_argues_for: An absence claim about a credential must name the search paths it covered and must be corroborated by a search whose scope is wider than the expected location. A negative capability claim is verified, never accepted — including when the lane making it is the one that wrote the rule.
A_MEASUREMENT_ERROR_THIS_LANE_MADE_AND_C.net_effect_on_this_determination: The VERDICT is UNCHANGED (LIMB_3 unsatisfied, ARMED false) but the REASONING is materially different: the blocker is not credential absence, it is credential expiry plus undeterminable scope plus the executor-binding structure. R3-1 below is the corrected reason.

MEASUREMENT_PERFORMED.method: Local filesystem and environment inspection only. No network call, no control-plane read, and no credential VALUE read, printed, or recorded anywhere. Only presence, path, non-secret expiry and non-secret identity metadata were examined.

PLANE-V_vercel.shape_measured_by_key_names_only: The file carries token, refreshToken, userId and expiresAt. The presence of a refreshToken alongside an expiring access token identifies this as a Vercel CLI OAuth SESSION credential rather than a manually-minted scoped access token. NO value of token, refreshToken or userId was read, printed, or recorded.

expiry_measured.why_the_expiry_is_recorded: An expiry timestamp is not a secret, and it is exactly the kind of fact RC-9a exists to surface: a credential's authority is bounded in time as well as in scope.

PLANE-V_vercel.active_team_scope: config.json in the same directory carries a currentTeam value, so the CLI session is bound to a team context. The value is not recorded here; the executing lane records it as part of its own RC-9a, together with the scope that team context confers.
PLANE-V_vercel.why_scope_could_not_be_established: A Vercel OAuth session credential does not carry its permissions on disk. Determining what it may read or mutate requires an API call, which is not one of the nine reads enumerated in READS, and RC-10 refuses any operation the authority does not enumerate.
PLANE-V_vercel.consequence: A Vercel credential EXISTS but is EXPIRED and its scope is UNDETERMINED. RC-9a for PLANE-V cannot be discharged from it: an expired credential's blast radius is not recordable as a present fact, and a refresh would be a network operation whose success is unknown without performing it.
PLANE-V_vercel.why_this_cannot_be_worked_around: Recording a scope that was not established would be inventing it, which AC-1's LIMB_3, this lane's directing mission, and manifest control NB-3 each prohibit independently.

PLANE-G_github.provenance_establishable: PARTIALLY. The GitHub CLI is configured for host github.com with user lorenzozanello and git_protocol https. The hosts.yml file contains NO token field, so the credential is held in the operating system keyring rather than on disk. This was established by reading only key names and non-secret values; no token was read or recorded.
PLANE-G_github.why_scope_could_not_be_established: A GitHub token's scopes are reported only by the API's response headers. Obtaining them requires a network call that is NOT one of the nine reads enumerated in READS, and RC-10 refuses any operation the authority does not enumerate. This lane declined to make that call rather than perform an unenumerated operation to satisfy a control.
PLANE-G_github.what_was_deliberately_NOT_inferred: That prior successful git pushes and pull-request operations in this branch's history imply a particular token scope. That is an inference from an operation having succeeded, not a scope measurement, and manifest control NB-3 refuses exactly it.

A Vercel CLI OAuth session credential exists but expired at 2026-09-22T08:02:56Z, roughly 13 hours 23 minutes before this evaluation, and its permissions are not recorded on disk. Four of the nine reads target Vercel. AC-1's per_plane_bound requires RC-9a for every plane in the intended read set, and manifest control NB-4 refuses a partial-plane RC-9a as discharging LIMB_3.
THREE_INDEPENDENT_REASONS_LIMB_3_FAILS.correction_notice: An earlier draft of this reason asserted that NO Vercel credential existed. That was FALSE and is superseded here; see A_MEASUREMENT_ERROR_THIS_LANE_MADE_AND_CORRECTED. The limb still fails, on expiry and undetermined scope rather than on absence.

THREE_INDEPENDENT_REASONS_LIMB_3_FAILS.reason: RC-9a BINDS THE EXECUTOR, AND THIS IS NOT THE EXECUTOR. RC-9's own text binds 'the acting lane' before ITS first read. This is an authoring lane that performs no read. Even a complete provenance record of THIS session's credentials would not describe the credentials a future read-executing lane will hold, possibly on another machine. A provenance record written in advance for a party that does not yet exist is not provenance.

NEITHER PLANE's SCOPE IS OBTAINABLE FROM AN AUTHORIZED, NON-SECRET, LOCAL SOURCE. A GitHub token's scopes live in an API response header; a Vercel OAuth session credential's permissions live server-side. Obtaining either requires a network operation the authority does not enumerate, and RC-10 refuses unenumerated operations.
THREE_INDEPENDENT_REASONS_LIMB_3_FAILS.the_gap_this_exposes: See DERIVED_FINDING_DF-11 below. RC-9a demands a fact that no operation enumerated in READS can produce, while RC-10 forbids reaching outside that enumeration to get it.

DERIVED_FINDING_DF-11.finding: RC-9a REQUIRES A CREDENTIAL SCOPE THAT NO ENUMERATED OPERATION CAN PRODUCE.
DERIVED_FINDING_DF-11.derivation: RC-9a obliges the executor to record 'what scope or permission it carries' for each plane. A credential's scope is a server-side fact: for GitHub it is returned in an API response header, for a Vercel OAuth session it is held by the provider. READS enumerates nine operations and none of them is a credential-introspection call. RC-10 states that any operation not enumerated in READS is refused and escalated as an authority question rather than performed.
DERIVED_FINDING_DF-11.the_hazard: A conscientious executor is caught between two controls of the same authority: it cannot discharge RC-9a without an operation RC-10 refuses. The likely resolutions are both bad — perform the unenumerated call quietly, or record a scope inferred from what previously happened to succeed, which NB-3 refuses as an inference rather than a measurement.
DERIVED_FINDING_DF-11.relationship_to_the_RC-9_circularity: This is the SECOND instrument defect in the same control. The v1.0.2 amendment fixed the TIMING defect (RC-9b depended on G-R1, which depends on arming). DF-11 is a distinct INSTRUMENT defect: even RC-9a, correctly timed, names no admissible way to obtain half of what it asks for. Fixing the first did not fix the second, and this lane does not fix the second.
DERIVED_FINDING_DF-11.why_it_is_recorded_and_not_fixed_here: Closing it means either enumerating a credential-introspection operation as an authorized non-read, or narrowing RC-9a to facts obtainable locally. Both change what the authority permits, which exceeds this lane's declared mode. It is named so the lane that resolves LIMB_3 encounters it before it is blocked by it, rather than after.
DERIVED_FINDING_DF-11.what_it_does_NOT_excuse: It does not license arming without RC-9a, and it does not license an invented scope. An unresolvable control fails closed.

LIMB_3_RC9_EXECUTOR_PROVENANCE.what_this_determination_does_NOT_claim: It does not claim the reads are unperformable or that no credential could be provisioned. It claims only that, at this acting state and by this lane, RC-9a cannot be discharged honestly: the Vercel credential present is expired, neither plane's scope is obtainable by an enumerated operation, and RC-9a binds an executor this lane is not. A lane holding live executor credentials can discharge most of it quickly, subject to DF-11.
